Data Scientist.description: Analyzes large datasets to discover patterns, build predictive models, and support data-driven decision making.

Backend Developer.description: Builds and maintains server-side logic, APIs, and databases that power web applications.

Software Engineer.description: Designs, develops, and maintains software systems using strong programming fundamentals and problem-solving skills.

Data Engineer.description: Builds and maintains data pipelines, warehouses, and infrastructure that enable data analysis at scale.
